title: Josiah knows about Max's nap and the 'First Fruits' chapter
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Josiah knows about Max's nap and the 'First Fruits' chapter, about unspecified at Max Davis's home, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: writes the next day you know I hope your nap was nice

plain: A filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made a documentary called The Telepathy Tapes about nonspeaking children said to read minds, tells a story about a boy named Josiah and a man named Max Davis. According to Dickens, after Max took a nap at his home, Josiah wrote to him the next day, "I hope your nap was nice," and also seemed to know about a chapter Max was writing called First Fruits. If true, it would suggest the boy knew things he had no ordinary way of knowing.
